title: coriaria ruscifolia subsp. microphylla
intro: Coriaria ruscifolia subsp. microphylla, commonly known as the New Zealand pepper tree, is a subspecies of the Coriaria ruscifolia plant, a flowering plant in the Coriariaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Coriaria ruscifolia subsp. microphylla include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as coriarian and corioside, exhibit therapeutic actions like antimicrobial, antihistaminic, and vasodilatory effects, making it a potential remedy for cardiovascular and respiratory issues.
